intro: Repositories are extra plugin lists run by other people. Mumcord does not review their plugins. Only add a repository you trust.

add.title: Add repository
add.expectedKeyHint: If the owner gave you a key, paste it here. The repository must then use exactly this key.
add.subtitle: Only add repositories from people you trust.
add.warningBody: Mumcord does not review these plugins. This key is remembered: if it ever changes, the repository is paused until you check it. Browsing it shows your IP address to its host. Plugins with official names are never taken from it.

limit: You can add up to {{max}} repositories.
limitReached: The limit of {{max}} repositories is reached.
loadFailed: The repositories could not be loaded.

remove.label: Remove {{name}}
remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: The repository is removed and its plugins are turned off. They stay installed with their data, but get no more updates.

keyChange.title: {{name}} changed its key
keyChange.message: This repository now signs its plugin list with a different key. It stays paused until you decide. Only trust the new key if the owner told you about the change.

mirror.title: Advanced
mirror.label: Mirror for the official plugin list (optional)
mirror.hint: Only change this if you were given a mirror address. The mirror must serve the same signed files; Mumcord still checks every signature.
